_note: Regeneration recipe for the tempdoc-789 F1/F2 naturalistic-replication substrate. No corpus/query/answer CONTENT is committed here (matching the established convention for every other real-external-dataset member -- 666-corpora/*/recipe.json, 707-corpora/*/member.v1.json -- none of which check in fetched text, only method/source/seed). Only cells.v1.json's hashes are committed as the frozen identity.

answers_resolution.finding: HuggingFace datasets-server first-rows API (queried live 2026-07-29) confirms MichaelR207/enron_qa_0922 carries gold_answers (+ rephrased_questions, alternate_answers, incorrect_answers, gold_rationales, alternate_rationales), index-aligned with questions.
answers_resolution.decision: Do NOT project gold_answers. tempdoc 707's founder-ratified 'EnronQA email-member source decision' memo (707, section 'Founder memo -- EnronQA email-member source decision', ratified 2026-07-16) already investigated this exact HF dataset's QA-annotation layer for a sibling corpus member and found it unlicensed (no HF license tag/field/file; arXiv 2505.00263 states no dataset redistribution terms for the annotation layer) -- and ratified dropping that layer entirely in favor of real public-domain email text (FERC/CMU precedent) plus the project's OWN gold. This recipe applies the same resolution: keep the real `questions` field (the pre-existing, years-long mixed/enron-qa usage predating 707, tempdoc 666's 'working, register-validated mixed/ corpora'), synthesize an independent reference answer locally instead of reading gold_answers off the HF row.
answers_resolution.synthesis_method: local model (Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M, out-of-band llama-server, temperature=0, thinking disabled), prompt scripts/jseval/789-corpora/enron-qa-answers/answer-synthesis-prompt.v1.txt, input = (question, FULL untruncated gold email text)
answers_resolution.scoring_implication: Reference answers are advisory to an LLM judge, not exact-match ground truth -- the launch's judge-overlay is mandatory (789 P2 probe convention), consistent with this design.

sanity_filters: qrel gold doc id exists in corpus.jsonl

gold email <= max_email_chars (added after a first pass at unlimited length produced 4/20 degenerate synthesized answers on the 4 longest gold emails, 7.2KB-56.8KB -- tempdoc 789 dated section has the before/after)

answer_synthesis.regenerate: python synthesize_answers.py --corpus-dir <materialized mixed/enron-qa> --selected selected.json --base-url http://127.0.0.1:<port> --seed 42 --out synthesized-answers.json --queries-out queries.json

closed_book_screen.method: local-model-proxy (NOT the sonnet closed-book calibration the real campaign runs)
